title: 44 Mins That Could Change How You Invest in This Market Correction | Rahul Jain G2G
creator: Rahul Jain
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; Good to Great collaboration video, guest D. Prasad (Definedge Securities board member, 35 years in markets)
summary: In this Good to Great collaboration interview, guest D. Prasad refuses to call a market bottom: the course depends on crude, the rupee and the US midterm elections on 3 Nov. Nifty near 22,000-22,200 (levels cited in the interview, below the about 22,800 cited in Rahul Jain's own video the same day) is strong support only if crude holds; if crude spikes to $130-140 and sustains, 22,000 could break toward 21,700 or 21,000, while crude back near $100 would relieve the market. His portfolio advice is split by horizon: long-term investors should hold core holdings with a good 2-3 year business outlook, swing and positional traders should sit on the fence, and everyone should flex only 10-15% cash rather than going fully to cash or fully invested. For fresh money he would put 50% into growth stocks expected to grow for three years, led by data-center pick-and-shovel players (coolants, racks, GPUs, connectivity, power) with full three-year order books and no debt, plus ancillary power, CDMO, space and corrected defence names — but only names with numbers, picked bottom-up. Sterlite Technologies is cited as an example of a narrative-led rise and explicitly not a recommendation. He is cautious on fallen blue chips (banks, pharma, FMCG, passenger vehicles down 40-50%): wait for base building and weekly or monthly highs, phase any buying into four parts, and switch out of hopeless holdings into rising sectors. IT is a trading bet only, not a long-term investment, given headwinds and rich valuations. Wealth-management and capital-market stocks, corrected sharply in the last seven days, rally if LTCG tax relief comes. Gold and silver stay on radar only with no entry until a base builds. Calls (guest views, attributed to Rahul Jain per the collab rule): DATA CENTER THEME CONDITIONAL_BUY, WEALTH MANAGEMENT / CAPITAL MARKET STOCKS CONDITIONAL_BUY, INDIA IT AVOID as an investment (trading bounces excepted), GOLD AVOID (reiterates prior AVOID). No individual stock recommendations and no stated Rs price levels.
